title: Tillman Creek Timberland
summary: Tillman Creek Timberland is a great mix of cover types offering a diversity of wildlife habitat from bottomlands/bays to Longleaf sand hills. Highway 19 frontage and only a few miles from Lumber City. 5 miles from the confluence of the Oconee and Ocmulgee Rivers, this is a rare corridor for all types of wildlife. Contact Garrett Williams for details 706-296-5365
